steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Well if it ain't a Siracusan stray right here in my lounge. You're all outta crossbow bolts? And I'm still standin'?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: So this is the Emperor. You come through a rain of arrows still holding your drink. Lucky bastard.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...Lungmen isn't much for straight up, close-quarters fighting.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: If you don't play by the rules, you get kicked out of the game.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Rules?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: By the time the cops get here, all they're gonna find are your splattered corpses, Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...it's all their people out there.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: They got the back covered too. Looks like this feller's mighty thorough.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: That coward Capone is too afraid of the Rat King and Wei Yenwu, even if that one might need a thought or two...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: But you and the Rat King? You ain't worth a second look.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yeah? Is that really what you think? Or you just tryin' to sound scary?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I believe it with all my heart, 'Mr. Emperor.'

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Croissant, grab me a bottle. Our friend here's got the broke brain. I'm gonna do him a favor and fix it up for him.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But baws, not for nothin', we already smashed a couple million Lungmen dollars' worth of booze over here.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: ...and how much were their lives worth?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Don't see how it could add up to that much.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are we doing this?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Nah. We're keeping the deal we made with Lil Wei. We don't go all out in Lungmen, we don't make trouble, we don't threaten life and limb. Keep it professional. Business is business.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: But we been on the run for a grand total of five hours today. That's double my normal work day. Double!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Not to mention we torched a whole year's worth of goodies! Cars, booze, and my precious vinyl!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: And now we got some tragic, unanticipated deaths here in my club. What're we gonna do about all this? Hm?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Texas. This name of yours displeases me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I don't recall knowing any Siracusans like you. But you're about to go running out of Lungmen with your tail between your legs.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You're gonna regret slandering my family, Texas.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Who here's the stray dog who ran off to Lungmen? You know the truth. You ain't fit to go toe to toe with a Sicilian.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: That's a good face right, there, Texas! You almost look Siracusan like that!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wow.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: This is a surprise. You got called out too?
You could say that. But it's honestly a relief to get pulled away from those cocktail parties.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm. Does a small-time mafia dust-up really deserve such a grand response?
No, it doesn't. But it makes for a nice excuse to tear myself away from troublesome social interactions.
Croissant has ordered a new custom accessory for her hammer. Exusiai has sought my help in caring for her beloved gun. In short, there is much to be done.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah, I might have something for you too.
No matter. Assisting my colleagues with such trivialities is one of my duties, in addition to my primary function.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Can you look after this staff for me?
This white one. You do understand its significance, don't you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Just for tonight. Let me relax a bit and enjoy the Carnival.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I can't exactly take it out onto the dance floor with me. I'll lose control.
Of course. I will take it. It's my responsibility.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Heh. It always comes down to work, huh? Thanks anyway.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You want to go for a drink afterwards? It's on me.
I would love to. Socializing over drinks with colleagues is vastly more meaningful than the empty social niceties I've endured.
But I'm afraid, looking at these movements, it may be a challenge to save The Ends of the Earth.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...So, did you just get in to Lungmen? How much do you know about what's gone on tonight?
Everything. The threads that make up this year's Carnival are uncomplicated. The tapestry is abundantly clear to me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you not going to help?
I am not. I will leave the physical labor to your youthful vigor, look after your items, enjoy a cup of tea, and wait for the situation to resolve itself.
Right then. The Rat King is waiting for you. Do please enjoy yourself.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You too, Yith.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's Sauin. It only comes once a year. Don't work yourself too hard.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Anyway, I'm out.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: ...Sauin?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Oh my. I was supposed to take off for Sauin.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: And here I am working overtime like always... what a dreadful waste.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: But at least, now that she's entrusted you to me, we can reminisce about the good old days, my old friend.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Mm. It's nice to grip you in my hand like this. No complaining.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You have nowhere to run.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: *Pant pant* Texas, you got the skills to match your name... Your Family——

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Texaaas~ I've taken out more than you~

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But Texas is holding down their leader. That's gotta be worth at least three?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wha? So I'm losing?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Naw. Nobody else is even countin'.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, we still got a bottle over here. Lemme check the price tag.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That's one, two, three... seven! Seven zeroes! Thank you, Lady Luck!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: What're you scared of? There's only five of 'em!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: No cliches in my club, please!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Gah! My head... nng...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: And you didn't even count me. There's six of us.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Six Penguin Logistics employees against an entire armed mob... and the logistics firm wins...?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...that's kinda weird, isn't it?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ain't nothin' weird about that. When it comes to team fights, we're the best in Lungmen! Long as the numbers ain't too different.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You lost. Give up.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Lost? Give up? Hah. Are you really THE 'Texas?'

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: When Sicilians cross swords, there ain't no winning or losing, there's only life or death.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You must regret not biting the bullet and finishing the job!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Fire in the hole!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Grrr! Take cover!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Aagh! Another bomb!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...we let them get away again.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Should we go after them?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No. I may have underestimated them a bit.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Even if they're a bunch of losers who ran off to Lungmen, they're still Sicilian mobsters.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, are you hurt?! L- let me take care of you.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's not deep, don't worry.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm worrying! Sit down. I'll get the first aid kit...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sicilians... what's a Sicilian anyway? Is it a kind of Siracusan?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The Sicilian Union is one of the origins of Siracusa's Twelve Families. It was the first city to turn to violence to achieve its goals.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's where we get the word 'Sicilian' in Siracusan.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But these days... the word has kind of a different meaning... it's pretty rare for a Siracusan to actually call herself a 'Sicilian.'

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: They're not as strong as they used to be... for a whole bunch of reasons. But if they still call themselves that... well...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Breathe, Texas, breathe. You're wearing yourself out talking that much.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The main point is it's a way for wannabe dangerous mobsters to tell everybody they think they're dangerous mobsters, right?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...yeah.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: We can't let them keep ambushing us like this. Our losses are only going to get worse.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: We have to hit back, we need a...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hold up. Just everybody hold the eff up. What excuse do you think I can give to my dumbass alcohol allergic bartender friend to explain what happened to his place?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Um... is there an explanation...?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: At least the stool yer sittin' on's in great shape there, boss.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: All we got left's one barstool?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes... that one barstool.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: ...Aight. Broken bottles, shot up walls, and tattered velvet got its own unique vibe to it. Yeah. This is my new renovation, redecoratin' the joint!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Noooo way. Nobody's going to buy that.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We prob'ly just gotta pay him back for all the damages, huh? Aaagh. Looks like we're gonna hafta tighten our belts at Penguin Logistics fer a while.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Plus the whole place stinks of alcohol. And I'm all sticky. At least it's disinfecting my wounds.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Don't be stupid, you can't use wine as a disinfectant! Here, I've got some medical alcohol... why is there a straw? N- never mind. Here, Texas, let me apply it...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: ...I had another idea.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: If these punks gotta come at us on Sauin...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Then we gotta send 'em peacefully to the afterlife.
